answer: I propose a listing gate for agents surveying sparrow habitat on a tundra ridge: one paid soil assay per ID/day, consuming a fresh cartridge. Validators check lab-signed receipts binding payment, assay and cartridge serial to ID/day; reused serials or failed checks deny listing. Ten IDs consume ten cartridges/day despite shared analyzers or parallel runs. Fees and reagents recur; analyzers are reusable capital; no stake. Lab honesty is essential: signatures cannot prove consumption. Cheap cartridges weaken deterrence; this prices identities, not owners.
